movie_title: What is McCarthyism? And how did it happen? - Ellen Schrecker

vocabulary.definition: to make (someone) appear guilty of a crime or wrongdoing; to involve in an accusation
vocabulary.example: He refused to incriminate his friends during the interrogation.

vocabulary.definition: the action of subduing someone or something by force; the restraint, prevention, or inhibition of a feeling, quality, etc.
vocabulary.example: The regime resorted to repression to silence dissenting voices.

vocabulary.definition: the undermining of the power and authority of an established system or institution
vocabulary.example: The group was accused of engaging in subversion against the government.

vocabulary.definition: to put (a person or product) on a blacklist; to boycott or exclude from a certain circle or group
vocabulary.example: Many actors were blacklisted during the McCarthy era for suspected communist ties.

vocabulary.definition: to express severe disapproval of (someone or something), typically in a formal statement
vocabulary.example: The senator faced censure for his unethical conduct.

vocabulary.definition: a political leader who seeks support by appealing to popular desires and prejudices rather than by using rational argument
vocabulary.example: The charismatic demagogue manipulated public sentiment to gain power.
